formalizations.formalization: ∀ (a : Point) (b : Point) (c : Point) (D : Line) (BC : Line), ((twoLinesIntersectAtPoint BC D a) ∧ (twoLinesIntersectAtPoint BC D b) ∧ (twoLinesIntersectAtPoint BC D c)) → ((Triangle.area △ a:b:c = Triangle.area △ a:c:b))
formalizations.full_output: theorem example_thm (a b c : Point) (D BC : Line) (h1 : twoLinesIntersectAtPoint BC D a) (h2 : twoLinesIntersectAtPoint BC D b) (h3 : twoLinesIntersectAtPoint BC D c) : (Triangle.area △ a:b:c = Triangle.area △ a:c:b) := by

formalizations.formalization: ∀ (a : Point) (b : Point) (c : Point) (d : Point) (AB : Line) (BC : Line) (AC : Line) (AD : Line) (DB : Line) (DC : Line), ((formTriangle a b c AB BC AC) ∧ (formTriangle d b c DB BC DC) ∧ (¬(Line.intersectsLine AB DC)) ∧ (¬(Line.intersectsLine AC DB))) → (Triangle.area △ a:b:c = Triangle.area △ d:b:c)
formalizations.full_output: theorem example_thm (a b c d : Point) (AB BC AC AD DB DC : Line) (h1 : formTriangle a b c AB BC AC) (h2 : formTriangle d b c DB BC DC) (h3 : ¬(Line.intersectsLine AB DC)) (h4 : ¬(Line.intersectsLine AC DB)) : Triangle.area △ a:b:c = Triangle.area △ d:b:c := by

reference_formalization: ∀ (a b c d : Point) (AB BC AC BD CD AD : Line), formTriangle a b c AB BC AC ∧ formTriangle d b c BD BC CD ∧ distinctPointsOnLine a d AD ∧ ¬(AD.intersectsLine BC) ∧ d.sameSide c AB → Triangle.area △ a:b:c = Triangle.area △ d:b:c
nl_statement: Triangles which are on the same base and between the same parallels are equal to one another.  Let $ABC$ and $DBC$ be triangles on the same base $BC$, and between the same parallels $AD$ and $BC$. I say that triangle $ABC$ is equal to triangle $DBC$. <prf> Thus, triangle $ABC$ is equal to triangle $DBC$.Thus, triangles which are on the same base and between the same parallels are equal to one another.
